From: Alex Mercer <security@ledgerway.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ledgerway: potential auth anomaly — request for IR timeline & logs

Hi Jonas,

We're reaching out from Ledgerway SecOps. This morning our monitoring flagged a short-lived spike of requests that appeared to be using stale service tokens tied to our Redwood integration (app id: ledgerway-prod). We've preserved samples and we think it may be related to a key rotation that occurred last week.

Can you please: 1) confirm whether Redwood recorded any elevated failures or unusual auth checks between 2026-11-07 22:30 UTC and 2026-11-08 02:00 UTC; 2) provide a high-level incident timeline and the steps you plan to take; and 3) share an export of relevant auth logs and a brief IRP/contacts doc so we can align our post-incident review and SOC 2 evidence collection?

We attached two sample request headers (samples_attached.json) and a short telemetry snippet. We're aiming to complete our initial impact assessment by EOD PST today. If needed we can upload artifacts to an SFTP you provide or accept a presigned S3 link.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15m call if that helps.

Alex Mercer
Security Engineer, Ledgerway
security@ledgerway.com
Attachment: samples_attached.json (application/json)

Thanks Alex — and thanks for the samples. We've started a quick triage.

Short answers up front:
- We saw a brief spike in 401/403 errors for tokens issued to ledgerway-prod during the window you listed.
- No indications of data exfiltration from our side; the spike appears constrained to auth handshake failures and transient retries.
- We'll produce an export of the auth logs and a timeline.

Next steps I will own:
1) Internal log extraction (auth service + edge proxies) for 2026-11-07 22:00 UTC through 2026-11-08 03:00 UTC.
2) Deliver a one-page incident timeline and our current IRP contact list (redwood_irp_v3.pdf).
3) Share a manifest of exported files and presigned upload instructions or SFTP details — whichever you prefer.

To keep this moving, please confirm your preferred upload method (SFTP or presigned S3). If S3, indicate whether you want the presigned links scoped to a single file or a short-lived folder.

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik to prepare the export. I'll follow up in ~30–60 minutes with the initial manifest.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the patience. Attached and summarized below are the artifacts we prepared for your SOC 2 mapping and internal review.

What we included:
- redwood_irp_v3.pdf (IR contacts, escalation playbook, retention policy)
- log_export_manifest.csv (listing extracted files and SHA256 checksums)
- auth_edge_20261107_220000-20261108_030000.parquet (redacted — contains request_id, timestamp, result_code, token_hash)
- token_service_audit_20261107_220000-20261108_030000.jsonl (redacted events)
- samples_attached.json (you already have)
- s3_presigned_upload_instructions.txt (how to upload to the temporary folder we created)

How we shared the files: We created a single short-lived S3 folder and provided presigned PUT links (6 hour lifetime) for each file. For security/audit, each link is logged and an audit event is associated in our export manifest. Link to folder (presigned index): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-ledgerway-upload-placeholder

Redaction notes: PII was redacted according to our SOC 2 redaction checklist (only token_hashes, request_id, timestamps and result codes retained). If you need additional fields for correlation, tell us which attributes and we'll perform a narrow re-export.

Preliminary timeline (high level):
- 2026-11-07 23:45 UTC — first auth error spike detected by our telemetry.
- 2026-11-07 23:52 UTC — automated retries/rotations triggered in connector layer.
- 2026-11-08 00:10 UTC — token rotation job completed (normal schedule).
- 2026-11-08 00:12 UTC — a short window of elevated 401 responses, then return to baseline by 00:17 UTC.

Conclusion: Based on current artifacts, this looks like a timing window related to token rotation and retry behavior on the client side; we did not observe lateral movement or data plane access with rotated tokens. We will retain exports for 90 days per the retention policy and provide any additional evidence you require for audits.

If Ledgerway would like, we can schedule a 30m walkthrough with our SRE and IR leads to go through the manifest and the telemetry shapes.

Attachments: redwood_irp_v3.pdf (application/pdf), log_export_manifest.csv (text/csv), auth_edge_20261107_220000-20261108_030000.parquet (application/octet-stream - redacted), token_service_audit_20261107_220000-20261108_030000.jsonl (application/jsonl), s3_presigned_upload_instructions.txt (text/plain)
